'''Adam Józef Walanus''' (born 6 April 1952) is a geologist, physicist, data analyst, statistician, programmer and photographer.

== Biography ==
He attended {{ill|lt=Stanisław Staszic High School|Stanisław Staszic High School in Tarnowskie Góry|pl|II Liceum Ogólnokształcące im. Stanisława Staszica w Tarnowskich Górach}} in [[Tarnowskie Góry]],<ref>{{citeweb| url = https://lostaszic.pl/prof-dr-hab-inz-adam-walanus/| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20260521142635/https://lostaszic.pl/prof-dr-hab-inz-adam-walanus/| archive-date = 2026-05-21| accessdate = 2026-08-07| publisher = lostaszic.pl| title = Prof. dr hab. inż. Adam Walanus}}</ref> where he passed matura in 1971.<ref name="cv">{{citeweb| url = https://www.adamwalanus.pl/cv.html| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20251117072800/https://www.adamwalanus.pl/cv.html| archive-date = 2025-11-17| accessdate = 2026-08-07| title = Curriculum vitae| publisher = adamwalanus.pl}}</ref> In 1976 he graduated with a master's degree in technical physics from the [[Silesian University of Technology]] (''Politechnika Śląska'').<ref name="cv" /><ref name="naukapolska">{{citeweb| url = https://ludzie.nauka.gov.pl/ln/profiles/2iTKAdgpZzd| title = Prof. dr hab. inż. Adam Józef Walanus| publisher = ludzie.nauka.gov.pl| accessdate = 2026-08-07}}</ref> In 1983 he obtained [[doctorate]] at the [[AGH University of Kraków|AGH]] Institute of Physics and Nuclear Techniques.<ref name="cv" /><ref name="naukapolska" /> upon dissertation ''Obiektywizacja pomiaru w datowaniach metodą 14C''<ref name="naukapolskaarchiwum">{{citeweb| url = https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=55405&_k=4i3vx1| title = Prof. dr hab. inż. Adam Walanus| publisher = archiwum.nauka-polska.pl| accessdate = 2026-08-07}}</ref> supervised by Andrzej Zastawny.<ref>{{citeweb| url = https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/research?id=97269&_k=nys5ae| title = Obiektywizacja pomiaru w datowaniach metodą 14C| publisher = archiwum.nauka-polska.pl| accessdate = 2026-08-07}}</ref> From 1976 to 1998 he was employed at the Institute of Physics at the Silesian University of Technology.<ref name="cv" /> In 2002 he obtained habilitation.<ref name="cv" /><ref name="naukapolska" /><ref name="naukapolskaarchiwum" /> From 2007 to 2023 he was employed at the [[AGH University of Kraków|AGH]].<ref name="naukapolska" /> His research interests included [[radiocarbon dating]], [[data analysis]] and statistics in the natural sciences.<ref name="cv" /> In 1971, he received the Third Prize at the 2nd Polish Landscape Biennale in Kielce (in photography).<ref>{{citebook| last = Pierściński| first = Paweł | year = 1971| title = Katalog Ogólnopolskiej Wystawy Fotografii pt. "II Biennale Krajobrazu Polskiego"| place = Kielce}}</ref><ref>{{citeweb| url = https://www.adamwalanus.pl/biennale.html| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20260217053524/https://www.adamwalanus.pl/biennale.html| title = II Biennale Krajobrazu Polskiego| publisher = adamwalanus.pl| accessdate = 2026-08-07| archive-date = 2026-02-17}}</ref> In 2015, his photographs were shown at the exhibition ''Człowiek wśród ludzi'' at the {{ill|Wojewódzka Biblioteka Publiczna w Krakowie|pl|Wojewódzka Biblioteka Publiczna w Krakowie}}.<ref>{{citeweb| url = https://www.adamwalanus.pl/2015/wystawa/plakat.html| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20230412102716/https://www.adamwalanus.pl/2015/wystawa/plakat.html| title =  Wystawa fotografii Adama Walanusa – Człowiek wśród ludzi | publisher = adamwalanus.pl| accessdate = 2026-08-07| archive-date = 2023-04-12}}</ref> He is married, has two sons (born 1978 and 1985) and five grandchildren.<ref name="cv" />
